How this prototype works

Live video and chosen photographs are processed on your device. Freezing a frame stops the camera and uses one portrait for both drapes. Clearing, reloading or closing the page discards the session’s portrait. Downloading a comparison intentionally creates a file on your device.

The oval is a virtual portrait window. The surrounding color does not change the pixels inside it, or reproduce light reflected from real fabric. Cameras, lighting and displays affect recorded color. Use this to explore relationships and test impressions with physical fabric when it matters.

Lightness and chroma come from OKLCH. Comparisons use the final sRGB hex colors. Colors outside sRGB are fitted by reducing chroma. These measurements describe this image and these colors, and do not determine a season, undertone, attractiveness or health.

Face tracking uses a model downloaded from this site (about 23 MB on first use). Processing stays in your browser; the page has no analytics, upload endpoint or photo storage. If tracking is unavailable, use the framing controls.
